_about: T. E. Page (1850-1936), Fellow of St John's College, Cambridge, master at Charterhouse, later first editor of the Loeb Classical Library: school and college editions with English introductions and notes (London: Macmillan), raw IA. Horace, Q. Horati Flacci Carminum Libri IV, the Odes (new edition, 1890; first edition 1883); Virgil, Bucolica et Georgica (1898); The Acts of the Apostles, the Greek text as revised by Westcott and Hort, with explanatory notes (1886); The Acts of the Apostles, with introduction and notes, with A. S. Walpole (1895). Latin and Greek text editions kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling. Not taken: his Aeneid (first edition 1894), because the only scan found (aeneidofvirgil01virg) is a 1950s reprint and the 1960s copies are later still. Classical scholarship (lane B, round dt). No uids minted.

t-e-page-horace-odes-1890: Q. Horati Flacci Carminum Libri IV, the Odes of Horace, with introduction and notes by T. E. Page, new edition (London: Macmillan, 1890; first edition 1883, reprinted 1886, 1889); Latin text with English notes, kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling
t-e-page-bucolica-georgica-1898: Virgil, Bucolica et Georgica, with introduction and notes by T. E. Page (London and New York: Macmillan, 1898); Latin text with English notes, kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling
t-e-page-acts-greek-1886: The Acts of the Apostles, being the Greek text as revised by Drs. Westcott and Hort, with explanatory notes by Thomas Ethelbert Page (London: Macmillan, 1886); Greek text with English notes, kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling
t-e-page-walpole-acts-1895: The Acts of the Apostles, with introduction and notes by T. E. Page and A. S. Walpole (London: Macmillan, 1895)
